note: AUDIT ONLY; nothing perturbed in V3.9A

anchor_offset_s.rationale: state-derived, not a global parameter; perturbing breaks causal meaning

dynamics_primary_decay.rationale: fixed constant with admitted candidates; no fitted uncertainty

regime_std_s.meaning: era/global empirical residual std with sample counts
regime_std_s.rationale: standard error of the std estimate is derivable from frozen (std, n)

rho_ar1.provenance: reference 0.264 (V3.2A measurement); re-estimated per fold; stability bound |rho|<=0.8
rho_ar1.rationale: executable range must be compiled from frozen per-fold estimates, not invented

range_rule: range ONLY from fitted uncertainty / empirical distribution / documented calibration / justified domain source / frozen evidence; arbitrary ±%, aesthetic, visibility-seeking, or future-informed ranges PROHIBITED

rng_policy_crn.limitation_reporting: if a parameter change alters topology so CRN correspondence is invalid, the future experiment must explicitly report it
rng_policy_crn.rule: compare configurations under COMMON RANDOM NUMBERS (same root seed, sim_id, stream family, future identity) so draw noise does not masquerade as sensitivity
